description:
Encrypt DNS requests without routing all your traffic through a VPN.

Protect your DNS requests with encrypted DNS-over-HTTPS, while your other internet traffic stays on its normal connection. SparkleDNS gives you control over DNS without routing your whole device through a VPN server.

  • Send DNS queries to your chosen DoH server using RFC 8484.
  • Check server protocol and latency before you connect.
  • See live queries and stats, filter activity, and block domains with a tap.
  • Add custom domain rules or blocklists by URL, including HaGeZi Pro++ and TIF presets.
  • Let selected apps bypass the DNS tunnel.
  • Connect or disconnect in one tap, or use the Quick Settings tile.

SparkleDNS creates a local VPN tunnel to capture DNS traffic only. DNS requests go to your selected DoH server; everything else uses your regular connection. Switch servers while connected and the tunnel restarts automatically. No analytics or Google Play Services are included.

Choose SparkleDNS for a lightweight Android DNS client with clear controls over encrypted DNS and domain blocking. Install SparkleDNS and take control of your DNS requests.
